title: Perfect powers in sequences of polygonal numbers
summary: Let $P_s(n)$ denote the $n$-th $s$-gonal number. Consider the Diophantine equation $P_{s}(n) = t^{m}$ for integers $n, s, t$ and $m > 2$. All solutions to this equation are known for $m>2$ and $s\in\{3,5,6,8,10,20\}$. Here we extend these results to the cases $s = 2k+4$ (where $k = 4,6$ or $5 \leq k \leq 97$ is a prime number) and $s = k+4$ (where $k = 9,15$ or $3 \leq k \leq 97$ is a prime number). The proofs of our results use the modular and hypergeometric methods, linear forms in logarithms and extensive calculations. We were unable to completely solve the above Diophantine equations,…
